examples.subject: maths
examples.q: The temperature is -12°C. It rises by 8°C. What is the final temperature?
examples.hint: Start at -12. An increase moves right; a decrease moves left. Follow the changes in order.
examples.check: Undo the changes in reverse order: -4 − 8 = -12.
examples.error_note: This does not follow all the signed changes. Start at the given value and apply each increase or decrease in order.

examples.hint: Start at -12. An increase moves right; a decrease moves left. Follow the changes in order.
